main_result.description: Successful execution of the gateway-to-vault CALL consumes the grouped byte producer through the actual bytes[] ABI and vault body. The result derives configured-gateway authorization, exact fee and one width-valid source/target request per decoded pair, with the same consumer world and static/value-call trace. Failed vault calls restore the caller world before value transfer. Full gateway-entry and producer-memory correspondence remain open.
main_result.model: Source gateway-to-vault call frame using corrected Solidity bytes[] ABI, actual fee STATICCALL and request CALLs in the existing live world

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.actual_gateway_vault_requests
theorems.doc:
/-- Actual gateway-to-vault CALL success derives authorization, exact fee,
width-valid decoded requests and the consumer world/trace. Full gateway
prefix and array-allocation provenance remain internal composition work. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem actual_gateway_vault_requests (callee : External) (sexternal : StaticCall.External)
    (ctx : Context) (vault gateway inbox : Address) (value : Live.Word)
    (groups : List WitnessGroupBytes) (before : World) (returned : Bytes)
    (h : (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).outcome = .ok returned) :
    ctx.self = gateway ∧
    ∃ sources targets data sats attempts,
      decodeVaultArgs (gatewayVaultArgs (GatewayCall.sourceArray groups) (GatewayCall.targetArray groups)) = some (sources, targets) ∧
      sources.length ≠ 0 ∧ sources.length = targets.length ∧
      lowLevelStaticCall sexternal vault inbox [] (transfer before ctx.self vault value.val) =
        ⟨.ok data, sats⟩ ∧
      data.length = 32 ∧ sources.length * (Live.word (decode data)).val = value.val ∧
      (∀ p ∈ pairsOf sources targets, widthOk p) ∧
      attempts.map (·.request) = hopRequests ⟨vault, ctx.self⟩ inbox
        (Live.word (decode data)) (pairsOf sources targets) ∧
      (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).world =
        (addConsolidationRequestsLoop callee ⟨vault, ctx.self⟩ inbox (Live.word (decode data))
          (pairsOf sources targets) (transfer before ctx.self vault value.val)).world ∧
      (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).attempts =
        [⟨⟨ctx.self, vault, value,
          gatewayVaultCalldata GatewayCall.selector (GatewayCall.sourceArray groups) (GatewayCall.targetArray groups)⟩,
          true, [], sats ++ GatewayCall.callTrace attempts⟩]

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.actual_gateway_vault_failure_restores
theorems.doc:
/-- Failure of this actual vault CALL restores the caller world before its
value transfer. This is the call-frame rollback, not the full gateway entry. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem actual_gateway_vault_failure_restores (callee : External) (sexternal : StaticCall.External)
    (ctx : Context) (vault gateway inbox : Address) (value : Live.Word)
    (groups : List WitnessGroupBytes) (before : World) (fault : Fault)
    (h : (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).outcome =
      .error fault) :
    (GatewayCall.execute callee sexternal ctx vault gateway inbox value groups before).world = before

covered: The high-level call checks code presence and uses the concrete a75ac640 selector and corrected offset-table/padded bytes[] encoder. The vault interpreter consumes that calldata and the actually credited world.

Configured gateway authorization is independent of request.caller. Fee is read by STATICCALL; checked fee multiplication, exact value and per-pair source/target width guards precede the request CALLs.

Successful execution connects the decoded requests, actual consumer world and complete static/CALL trace. Source custom-error payloads and panic bytes are encoded in the runtime; outer failure rolls back the whole vault call frame.

The byte producer is preparePairBytes on grouped source/target bytes, not an independently supplied Nat identity. No separate vault success, funding, positive fee, callee frame or array-width premise is supplied.
missing: Full gateway entry: role/pause and deposit preconditions, locator/withdrawal credentials, witness validation, quota, count and fee lookup, actual producer allocation and refund composition.

Initialization must bind immutable configuration and producer memory extents; the existing ABI round trip requires these bounds. The current public result identifies the actually decoded arrays, without silently equating arbitrary unbounded producer arrays with their encoded/decoded representation.

Malformed ABI elements are decoded eagerly here, while Solidity accesses them lazily after the fee read. Exact failure precedence/traces on malformed calldata and deployed LOG topics/data remain open.

The inherited low-level primitive treats code-less targets as EOAs and does not dispatch precompiles. The real EIP7251 body and its physical queue are not supplied by this public consumer; no simplified predeploy or arbitrary-callee balance frame is promoted to deployed correspondence.
conditions: Successful actual invocation is the sole execution premise; all guards and successful internal stages in the result are derived.
Gateway and inbox configuration are parameters awaiting constructor/deployment binding; the arbitrary callee operates under the declared live-world CALL/STATICCALL semantics.

The historical vault model and its gateway-admitted-nonzero premise remain separate conditional evidence. The new consumer neither assumes a positive fee nor targets equality with that historical model.
outside: General compiler correctness, declared Verity semantics, cryptographic primitives, general gas and consensus remain at their accepted boundaries. No stronger premise is accepted under those labels.

summary: source_consolidation_preserves_eligibility_value_atomicity: sourceRun commits iff caller=gateway, nonempty aligned 48-byte keys, product fits, msg.value = count*fee (_requireExactFee). Chantier 2 (Thomas 2026-09-13) fixes the guard order in the registered model to match Solidity exactly (WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:56-73): bound check (Panic 0x11 on multiplication overflow) then _requireExactFee (IncorrectFee revert if msg.value != requiredFee) then loop _validatePublicKey (InvalidPublicKeyLength revert on the first non-48-byte key). The prior model hoisted the whole-batch key validation before the fee guard; committed batches were unchanged, but a batch that failed both guards would report InvalidPublicKeyLength where Solidity reports IncorrectFee. The caller-supplied gateway-admitted-nonzero-value premise (caller=gateway -> msg.value != 0) is threaded into the proof and used: on any run satisfying it, the committed branch's own msg.value = count*fee equality forces fee != 0, so the theorem derives that conjunct instead of leaving the premise unused. Parent-refuting kill-line: fee_blind_commit_kill_line_refutes_parent evaluates the parent's hypothesis-conditioned committed-arm conjunction on the model mutant sourceRunFeeBlind (sourceRun with the exact-fee guard dropped) and falsifies it on a concrete committed batch that SATISFIES the premise (caller=gateway, msg.value=1, fee=0, one valid 48-byte pair): every fee-independent conjunct holds of that commit while fee != 0 fails. Premise-necessity evidence, separately: gateway_admitted_nonzero_kill_line shows that with the premise dropped a free batch (fee=0, msg.value=0) still commits sourceRun; that witness violates the premise, so it refutes only the hypothesis-free projection, not the hypothesis-conditioned parent. Packing-order kill-line: swapped source||target concat fails observe. Verity: if the four memory arrays decode, observe (state.calls/events) equals sourceView of the same sourceRun. Value-bearing CALL lift: the executed transaction credits msg.value at frame entry (credited), debits each journaled CALL (forwardCalls), and proves committed_preserves_eth_balance (post-run vault selfBalance equals the pre-call balance, the pinned preservesEthBalance modifier's assert, vault side) and committed_journal_forwards_msg_value (journal suffix frames are .success CALLs to the request target each carrying the per-request fee, summing to msg.value). Not beacon eligibility and not the Bus. Do not compose with P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1. The frame-entry credit is admissibility-guarded: a selfBalance + msg.value that would wrap Uint256 is rejected at entry (ENTRY_CREDIT_OVERFLOW via entry_credit_overflow_reverts) before decode, so committed runs certify a non-wrapping entry credit and fundable per-CALL debits.

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.source_consolidation_preserves_eligibility_value_atomicity
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-CONSOLIDATION-1, source plane.** A consolidation batch commits only if
every vault guard passes (caller = gateway, nonempty aligned 48-byte keys, the
product fits, `msg.value = count * fee`) with a nonzero fee, and then produces
exactly one CALL and one event per pair; it reverts only if some guard fails.

`sourceRun` commits only when caller = gateway, arrays are nonempty and
aligned, every key is 48 bytes, the product fits `uint256`, and
`msg.value` equals `count * fee` (`_requireExactFee`). In isolation `fee = 0`
with `msg.value = 0` commits `sourceRun`; under the caller-supplied
`hGatewayAdmittedNonzero` premise this parent additionally derives
`inputs.fee.val ≠ 0` for every committed run (the premise concerns the vault input, and the committed branch's own
`msg.value = count * fee` equality then forces a nonzero fee).
A revert implies the un-strengthened conjunction is false. Not beacon
eligibility and not the Bus.

**Vault-input premise, recorded as `A-CONSOLIDATION-GATEWAY-NONZERO`.**
`hGatewayAdmittedNonzero` is forwarded to the source theorem and used to
derive the `inputs.fee.val ≠ 0` conjunct above. It requires an authorized
vault call to carry nonzero `msg.value`. The gateway forwards `count * fee`,
not its entire outer payment; a positive outer payment can therefore coexist
with zero forwarded value. Discharging the premise requires a justified
positive forwarded fee as well as the composed argument/value path.
Two kill-lines pin the present claim:
`gateway_admitted_nonzero_kill_line` is premise-necessity evidence (dropped,
the same conjunct is false of `sourceRun` on a concrete free batch that
violates the premise), and `fee_blind_commit_kill_line_refutes_parent` is
the parent-refuting kill-line (on the mutant interpreter `sourceRunFeeBlind`
with the exact-fee guard dropped, a batch that SATISFIES the premise commits
while this parent's committed-arm conjunction is false of that commit). -/
theorems.statement:
theorem source_consolidation_preserves_eligibility_value_atomicity
    (inputs : Inputs)
    (hGatewayAdmittedNonzero : inputs.caller = inputs.gateway →
      inputs.msgValue.val ≠ 0) :
    CommitsOnlyWhenAllGuardsPass inputs ∧
    RevertsOnlyWhenSomeGuardFails inputs

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PConsolidation1.verity_tx_simulates_consolidation
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-CONSOLIDATION-1, Verity plane (Thomas 2026-09-13 retirement).**
Under the four decode premises and the entry no-wrap premise, the
slot-free companion transaction `addRequestsSlotFree` observed via the
slot-independent `observeFromJournal` equals `sourceView`. The
registered statement no longer reads the fabricated
`sourceMapSlot`/`targetMapSlot` from the executed state (retired here);
`observeFromJournal` derives `payloads` directly from the CALL journal
(`calls.map (·.input)`), matching the pinned Solidity behaviour at
`WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:114-115` (`request = source ‖ target`).

The entry no-wrap premise is the executed-plane funding condition: a
wrapping credit is turned away at entry (`entry_credit_overflow_reverts`)
rather than committed as wrapping CALL debits. Not 96-byte packed
calldata. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem verity_tx_simulates_consolidation (inputs : Inputs)
    (state : Verity.ContractState)
    (hCountBound : (state.readSlot countSlot).val + inputs.sources.length <
      Verity.Core.Uint256.modulus)
    (hEntry : state.selfBalance.val + inputs.msgValue.val <
      Verity.Core.Uint256.modulus)
    (hSources : readArray state "sources" sourcesBase inputs.sources.length =
      some inputs.sources)
    (hTargets : readArray state "targets" targetsBase inputs.targets.length =
      some inputs.targets)
    (hSourceLens : readArray state "sourceLens" sourceLensBase
      inputs.sourceLens.length = some inputs.sourceLens)
    (hTargetLens : readArray state "targetLens" targetLensBase
      inputs.targetLens.length = some inputs.targetLens) :
    observeFromJournal state ((addRequestsSlotFree inputs).run state) =
      sourceView inputs (state.readSlot countSlot).val

assumptions.risk: The vault-level theorem assumes that an authorized vault call carries nonzero msg.value. Thomas's 2026-09-13 mandate reformulates this as follows: **the premise is violable on-chain at fee = 0**. When the EIP-7251 consolidation-request predeploy returns `fee = 0` (the STATICCALL is well-defined at `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:79-93`, so a zero return is representable), the gateway forwards `totalFee = n * fee = 0` to the vault, `msg.value = 0` passes `_requireExactFee(0)`, and the vault commits a zero-value batch. The parent's positive-fee conjunct does not hold on that on-chain path. Therefore this assumption is NOT a claim about outer gateway payment positivity — it is a **caller-supplied constraint that fee is nonzero on the read path**. The Bus theorem `executeConsolidation_committed_forwards_msgValue` (`audit/trio/consolidation/Bus.lean:203`, PR #263) shows the Bus forwards the executor-supplied `msgValue` unchanged on the committed path, but that `msgValue` itself is a free parameter — this does not by itself derive fee positivity. Reclassed, not discharged.
assumptions.justification: Preferred derivation (Thomas 2026-09-13): `fee ≠ 0 → totalFee = n * fee ≠ 0` for any `n ≥ 1`. That derivation is pure arithmetic on `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:66` and the loop at 68-72; it turns the caller-supplied nonzero-`msg.value` premise into a nonzero-`fee` premise on the STATICCALL return at 79-93. The `fee = 0` case is explicitly documented as an on-chain path the premise does not cover.
assumptions.violation_impact: Without this premise, the modeled vault can accept a nonempty zero-fee batch with zero forwarded value. The positive-fee conclusion does not apply. The `fee = 0` on-chain path (EIP-7251 predeploy returning 0) is representable and admits committed zero-value runs.
assumptions.validation: Check the value forwarded by `ConsolidationGateway.addConsolidationRequests` at the pinned lines 212-222 (`totalFee = n * fee` per iteration) and the STATICCALL that reads `fee` from the EIP-7251 predeploy at `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:79-93` (`_getConsolidationRequestFee` → `_getFeeFromContract`, error cases `FeeReadFailed` at 87 and `FeeInvalidData` at 91). An ABI bridge alone does not derive fee positivity; the caller must justify the STATICCALL return being nonzero.
assumptions.removal_path: Derive positivity of the vault's forwarded value from a justified fee condition (the EIP-7251 fee being nonzero, live-read via STATICCALL at 79-93) and a composed calling path; or separately revise the theorem's positive-fee claim to accept the `fee = 0` on-chain path. PR #263 provides the Bus forwarding lemma but does not close either of those two obligations.

chantier 2 (Thomas 2026-09-13) error-name correspondence, matching `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol` guard-by-guard: (a) `msg.sender != CONSOLIDATION_GATEWAY` (`WithdrawalVault.sol:203`) reverts `NotConsolidationGateway`; (b) `requestsCount == 0` (line 61) reverts `ZeroArgument("sourcePubkeys")`; (c) `requestsCount != targetPubkeys.length` (62-63) reverts `ArraysLengthMismatch`; (d) `requestsCount * fee` checked-mul overflow (66, Solidity 0.8) reverts `Panic(0x11)`; (e) `msg.value != requiredFee` (`_requireExactFee` 123-127) reverts `IncorrectFee`; (f) `pubkey.length != 48` inside the loop (`_validatePublicKey` 97-101, called at 69-70) reverts `InvalidPublicKeyLength`. Guard order matches Solidity exactly after chantier 2 (bound → exact fee → per-key validation). Distinct from `ConsolidationGateway.sol:287-288 InsufficientFee` at the outer gateway (`P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1`)

**chantier 2 gateway→vault ABI-bridge linkage** (Thomas 2026-09-13): the P-CONSOLIDATION-ETH-1-side `gatewayVaultBoundary` in `LidoSRv3/Audit/Source/ConsolidationFeeStaticcallSource.lean` names the exact two scalars (`msgValue = totalFee`, `fee = abiDecodedFee`) that cross the gateway→vault frame boundary at `ConsolidationGateway.sol:220`, and `gatewayVaultBoundary_satisfies_exact_fee` proves the arithmetic identity `msgValue = requestsCount * fee` — exactly what the vault-side `_requireExactFee` guard (`WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:123-127`, `IncorrectFee` revert) enforces on `Inputs.msgValue` and `Inputs.fee` here. A caller composing the two legs by populating this vault's `Inputs.msgValue` and `Inputs.fee` from the gateway's `gatewayVaultBoundary` makes the `IncorrectFee` branch of the registered `sourceRun` unreachable — the vault commits on the count / bound / per-key-validation guards alone. Full Verity/executable composition (a `Contract.run` chaining both entrypoints across the frame boundary) remains OPEN.

**chantier 2 sourceMapSlot/targetMapSlot retirement — registered-parent statement change** (Thomas 2026-09-13). The registered Verity parent `verity_tx_simulates_consolidation` now directly states `observeFromJournal state ((addRequestsSlotFree inputs).run state) = sourceView …` — the fabricated `sourceMapSlot = 32` / `targetMapSlot = 33` slots no longer appear in the registered statement, and neither does the persistence variant that writes them. `observeFromJournal` derives `payloads` from `calls.map (·.input)`, matching the real Solidity carrier at `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:114-115` (`request = source ‖ target`); `addRequestsSlotFree` (`LidoSRv3/Audit/Verity/ConsolidationTx.lean`) is the slot-free executable transaction that uses `persistSlotFree` instead of `persist`. Proof: `observeFromJournal_simulates_pinned_source_slotFree` chains the slot-independence step (`observeFromJournal_simulates_pinned_source`) through the `Contract.run`-level slot-free companion equivalence (`observeFromJournal_run_addRequests_eq_observeFromJournal_run_addRequestsSlotFree`) and its raw-application predecessor (`observeFromJournal_addRequests_eq_observeFromJournal_addRequestsSlotFree`), which in turn compose the field-level agreements (`persist_calls_eq_persistSlotFree_calls`, `persist_events_eq_persistSlotFree_events`, `persist_readSlot_eq_persistSlotFree_readSlot`) with the shared-guard-structure case split (`addRequests_snd_calls_eq_addRequestsSlotFree_snd_calls`, `_snd_events`, `_snd_readSlot`, `_isSuccess`). The revert-rollback registered claim `verity_tx_revert_restores_snapshot` is likewise refactored to state the property on `addRequestsSlotFree`; rollback-by-construction is inherited from `Contract.run`'s uniform revert semantics (`revert_restores_snapshot_slotFree`). The old `verity_tx_simulates_consolidation_from_journal`, `verity_tx_simulates_consolidation_from_journal_slotFree`, `verity_tx_revert_restores_snapshot_slotFree`, and `verity_tx_slotFree_preserves_observation_predicate` intermediate aliases are retired — their content is now the parent statement itself. `addRequests` and `persist` remain in the module for callers that need the pre-retirement definitions (used by `Tests/ConsolidationTxMutants.lean` and the `ConsolidationValueTx` value-plane theorems), but the registered guarantee no longer references the fabricated slots.

chantier 2 (Thomas 2026-09-13) `RequestAdditionFailed` branch model in `LidoSRv3/Audit/Source/ConsolidationCorrespondence.lean`: `sourceRunWithCallOutcomes inputs callOutcomes` extends `sourceRun` with per-request CALL success flags mirroring the pinned `_callAddConsolidationRequest` at `WithdrawalVaultEIP7685.sol:113-121` (`(bool success,) = CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST.call{value: fee}(request); if (!success) revert RequestAdditionFailed(request);`). `sourceRunWithCallOutcomes_all_success_eq_sourceRun` proves that when every CALL flag is `true` and the list length matches the request count, the extended model reduces to `sourceRun` — i.e., `sourceRun` is the happy-path projection with the CALL branch abstracted. `sourceRunWithCallOutcomes_request_addition_failed_witness` is a non-vacuity witness: a gateway-authorized, nonempty, 48-byte-aligned batch with a valid exact fee but a single `false` CALL flag reverts `RequestAdditionFailed`. The `callOutcomes : List Bool` remains a caller-supplied summary of executable-plane success flags; deriving them from a live callee model on the pinned predeploy address remains OPEN.
